title: From Relevant Memories to Sufficient Evidence: Rethinking Memory Utilization in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to reuse past experiences, yet retrieving relevant memories does not necessarily provide sufficient evidence for answering a query. Essential information may remain fragmented across memory records, obscured by abstraction, or disconnected from the relations required for reasoning. We identify this relevance-sufficiency gap and propose QEMem, a framework that reformulates memory utilization as the construction of query-specific evidence sets, shifting the focus from individual retrieval relevance to collective evidential support. QEMem integrates three complementary mechanisms: query-guided discovery retrieves evidence across multiple memory granularities; source-grounded reification organizes it into structured ViewCards with explicit evidential roles and source references; and sufficiency-guided refinement selectively recovers missing information. translated_title: 从相关记忆到充分证据：重新思考LLM智能体中的记忆利用
translated_abstract: 长期记忆使LLM智能体能够复用过往经验，然而检索到相关记忆并不一定能为回答查询提供充分的证据。关键信息可能分散在不同的记忆记录中、被抽象化所遮蔽，或与推理所需的关系相互脱节。我们识别出了这种“相关性-充分性”差距，并提出QEMem框架，将记忆利用重新表述为构建针对特定查询的证据集合，将关注点从单个检索结果的相关性转向集体证据支撑。QEMem整合了三种互补机制：查询引导的发现（query-guided discovery）跨多个记忆粒度检索证据；基于来源的具体化（source-grounded reification）将证据组织成结构化的ViewCards，包含明确的证据角色和来源引用；充分性引导的精炼（sufficiency-guided refinement）选择性地恢复缺失信息。QEMem在现有记忆库上运行而无需对其进行修改（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出QEMem框架，将LLM智能体的记忆利用从“检索相关记忆”重新定义为“构建查询专属证据集合”，通过查询引导发现、来源具体化和充分性精炼三种机制弥合相关性-充分性差距。
en_tdlr: QEMem reformulates memory utilization in LLM agents as constructing query-specific evidence sets, bridging the relevance-sufficiency gap through query-guided discovery, source-grounded reification, and sufficiency-guided refinement.
